blurb: CrossTimbers Marina offers boat rentals including pontoons and paddle boards, a boat club membership, slip rentals, and lakeside cottage rentals. The marina is located on Skiatook Lake with 168 miles of shoreline and over 10,000 acres of water. Guests can explore the lake, enjoy waterfront cottages, and participate in boating activities.
